entries.subject: People Forum: Developing talent and skills at Oxford
entries.body:
Dear Colleagues,  

 

Staff with HR and People responsibilities are invited to join an online People Forum, hosted by the People Department, on Tuesday 15 September 2026. 

 

This session will focus on two important areas of professional development at Oxford – supporting internal mobility across professional services and developing the skills needed for the future. 

 

Agenda  

 

Chair: Renu Gupta, Director of Talent and Deputy HR Director 

 

1. Internal Mobility Principles: From pilot to implementation 
Laura Porter, Talent Mobility Specialist 

 

Following the pilot, the Internal Mobility Principles will become the minimum standards for moves within professional services at Oxford; helping to create greater consistency in how internal mobility is supported.    

 

Laura will share: 

*       what we learned from the 2025/26 Internal Mobility Principles pilot; and 

*       how those insights have shaped the refined principles for professional services roles across Oxford, ahead of their launch at the end of September. 

 

2. Building skills for the future: apprenticeships at Oxford 

Eleanor Jennings, Career Development Manager 

 

Oxford’s apprenticeship programme is earning national recognition. The University climbed 21 places in the Department for Work and Pensions’ 2026 Top 100 Apprenticeship Employers, remaining the only university on the list. 

 

Eleanor will explore: 

*       how the University’s growing apprenticeship programme can support career development for professional and technical staff; and 

*       how new apprenticeship opportunities can help departments build the skills they’ll need in the future, including: 

o   the recently launched AI and data apprenticeships; and 

o   the new Innovation & Change Leadership programme launching in September. 

 

I hope you can join us.  

 

Best wishes  

 

Renu Gupta, 

Director of Talent & Deputy HR Director
